english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday Cantonese noun for the joint between the foot and the leg.

examples.english: I walked all day yesterday, and my ankle hurts a bit.
examples.traditional: 我尋日行咗成日，腳眼有啲痛。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 cam4 jat6 haang4 zo2 seng4 jat6 goek3 ngaan5 jau5 di1 tung3
